name: forge-dashboard
description: Web dashboard for forge-cli / forge-server. Built by CMake, embedded into the binaries by cmake/EmbedDashboardAssets.cmake.

scripts.smoke: vite build --ssr scripts/smoke.ts --outDir dist-smoke --emptyOutDir && node dist-smoke/smoke.js
scripts.test: node scripts/test-markdown.mjs && vite build && node scripts/test-smoke.mjs && node scripts/test-bundle.mjs && node scripts/test-theme.mjs
